propositions: Empty file_impact field currently overloads two cases: author omission and genuinely no file impact, causing conservative whole-HEAD invalidation on any commit and poison-rule cascade to container drift scope.
Explicitly declaring no file impact with a tri-state (undeclared/paths/none) should preserve attestation validity across unrelated commits and prevent container poisoning.
A no-file-impact declaration must be part of the material fingerprint so that flipping states invalidates attestation and forces re-review.
A plan-review criterion must evaluate whether an explicit no-file-impact assertion is correct for the actual plan, triggered only when the assertion is present.
Containers with mixed children (some path-declaring, some explicitly no-impact) should inherit only the path-declaring union without poisoning from explicit-none children.
